$comment: Advisories in the production dependency tree that have been reviewed and accepted.
`scripts/audit-gate.mjs` fails the build on anything here that is NOT listed, and also
on anything listed that no longer appears — a stale exemption pre-approves a finding
nobody has looked at. The exposure analysis for each entry is in
docs/SecurityThreatModel.md under 'Dependency advisories'; this file holds the ids so
Adding an entry is a commit somebody reviews. There is no override flag.

accepted.reason: SmtpEmailProvider.send passes only from/to/subject/text/html — no envelope, list, raw, transport name or attachments — so the affected surfaces have no call path. Recipients are single stored addresses, never caller-supplied lists.
accepted.revisit: When nodemailer ships a fixed release, or when any of those options is used.

accepted.reason: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when a `buf` argument is supplied. Reached only through sequelize, which calls uuid without `buf`, and MeetFlow generates ids in PostgreSQL (gen_random_uuid) or through uuid v4 with no buffer.
accepted.revisit: When sequelize's uuid range moves past 11.1.1.
